name: dbt-airflow-lineage
description: Interactive dbt lineage graph that also shows which Airflow pipelines run and ingest each model, resolving dbt selectors (tags, graph operators, excludes). Edit model YAML in place.

dbtAirflow.projectDir.markdownDescription:
Folder of the dbt project (the one that contains `dbt_project.yml`). Leave empty to find it automatically in the workspace. Use it when the workspace holds several dbt projects.

Example: `my_dbt_project` or an absolute path.

dbtAirflow.manifestPath.markdownDescription:
Where `manifest.json` is, relative to the dbt project folder. The extension reads it to draw the lineage. Create or refresh it with `dbt parse`.

Default: `target/manifest.json`.

dbtAirflow.airflowPaths.markdownDescription:
Folders that hold Airflow DAG code, scanned for `.py` files. Absolute, or relative to the workspace. Used when `airflowSource` is `local`.

Example: `["../airflow/dags", "/Users/me/airflow/dags"]`.

dbtAirflow.dagsBucket.markdownDescription:
Google Cloud Storage folder with the Airflow DAGs, used when `airflowSource` is `gcs`. The extension signs in with your own `gcloud` account and only reads.

Example: `gs://my-airflow-bucket/dags`.

dbtAirflow.dbtCommand.markdownDescription: The command used by **dbt Airflow: Run dbt parse** (for example `dbt`, `uv run dbt` or `poetry run dbt`).

dbtAirflow.upstreamDepth.markdownDescription: How many levels **upstream** (parents) of the focused model the graph shows. Resets to 2 when you switch to another model file. Use the **+** buttons in the graph to explore further without changing this number.

dbtAirflow.downstreamDepth.markdownDescription: How many levels **downstream** (children) of the focused model the graph shows. Resets to 2 when you switch to another model file.

enumDescriptions: Use "local" when airflowPaths is set, otherwise no Airflow pipelines.
Read DAGs from the folder(s) in airflowPaths.
Mirror DAGs from a Google Cloud Storage bucket (dagsBucket).
dbtAirflow.airflowSource.markdownDescription:
Where the Airflow pipelines come from. The **Sync DAGs** button in the lineage view asks the first time you click it, and you can change it later with the command **dbt Airflow: Set up Airflow**.

- `auto`: use `local` when `airflowPaths` is set, otherwise no pipelines
- `none`: do not show Airflow pipelines
- `local`: read DAG code from the folders in `airflowPaths`
- `gcs`: copy DAGs from the bucket in `dagsBucket` (needs `gcloud`)

dbtAirflow.dagsDownloadDir.markdownDescription: Optional folder for the downloaded DAGs. The extension creates a sub-folder `airflow-dags-cache` there and only ever changes that sub-folder. Leave empty to use the extension's own storage.

dbtAirflow.dagsSyncExclude.markdownDescription: Regular expressions (Python syntax, matched against the path inside the bucket folder) for files that are **not** downloaded. The default copies only `.py` files and skips `tests` and `__pycache__` folders, so test data in a bucket is never downloaded. Patterns cannot contain commas.

dbtAirflow.ai.enabled.markdownDescription:
Optional AI. Lets your editor's AI agent (the VS Code agent or the Cursor agent) ask this extension about your lineage, for example which reports a model change impacts, which pipelines run it, or what a selector picks. Off by default: when off, nothing is registered and nothing is sent anywhere.

The **Ask AI** button asks for confirmation and turns this on for you. In Cursor it sets up a local MCP server (a small program on your machine, read-only, no network). The AI only receives model, report and pipeline names, never SQL or data.

dbtAirflow.reports.include.markdownDescription:
What counts as a **report** for the **Impact** button and the AI questions. A list of sources that are **combined**; add as many as you need. Click **Impact** in the lineage view to build the list with a picker, or edit it here.

Each entry is one of:

- `exposures`: every dbt exposure (`exposure:weekly_*` for some by name)
- `tag:report`: models with that tag
- `folder:reporting`: models under a folder, by name or path (`folder:models/reporting`)
- `file:rpt_pnl.sql`: one file or model (`file:models/marts/rpt_pnl.sql`)
- `path:models/marts`: a dbt path selector
- any dbt selector, for example `tag:finance,config.materialized:view` or `rpt_*`

Example combining several places:

```json
"dbtAirflow.reports.include": [
  "exposures",
  "tag:report",
  "folder:one_reporting_views",
  "file:rpt_pnl.sql"
]
```

Sources (tables) are never reports.

dbtAirflow.reports.exclude.markdownDescription: Entries taken **out** of the reports again, written like `reports.include`. For example `["tag:draft", "folder:sandbox"]`.

dbtAirflow.critical.include.markdownDescription:
Which models are **critical**, for the **Impact** button and the AI questions. The Impact panel lists the critical models a change reaches next to the reports. Same entries as `reports.include`, combined:

- `tag:critical`: models with that tag
- `folder:regulatory_reports`: models under a folder
- `file:fct_loan.sql`: one file or model
- `path:models/core`, or any dbt selector such as `tag:pii,config.materialized:table`

Example:

```json
"dbtAirflow.critical.include": ["tag:critical", "folder:regulatory_reports", "file:fct_loan.sql"]
```

Sources (tables) are never critical models. Choose them with the picker: **dbt Airflow: Choose which models are critical…**

dbtAirflow.critical.exclude.markdownDescription: Entries taken **out** of the critical models again, written like `critical.include`.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Airflow pipelines are optional. Connect a local DAGs folder or a Google Cloud Storage bucket to see which pipelines run each model.
[Set up Airflow pipelines](command:dbtAirflow.setupAirflow)

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_find_models
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find dbt models, sources, seeds or snapshots by part of a name, path, or tag:<name>. Use it first when you only have an approximate name.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find dbt models, sources, seeds or snapshots by part of a name, path, or tag:<name>.

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_lineage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Upstream and downstream lineage of one model, limited to a number of levels.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Upstream and downstream lineage of one model, limited to a number of levels.

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_impacted_reports
languageModelTools.modelDescription: What is affected if this model changes: the reports and the critical models downstream of it, with the shortest path and the Airflow pipelines (and schedules) that run each. What counts as a report or a critical model depends on the project settings.
languageModelTools.userDescription: What is affected if this model changes: the reports and the critical models downstream of it, with the shortest path and the Airflow pipelines (and schedules) that run each.

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_pipelines_for
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Which Airflow pipelines run this model (via their dbt selectors) or load its table.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Which Airflow pipelines run this model (via their dbt selectors) or load its table.

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_models_for_pipeline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Which dbt models an Airflow pipeline (DAG) selects.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Which dbt models an Airflow pipeline (DAG) selects.

languageModelTools.name: dbtairflow_resolve_selector
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The models a dbt selector picks (like `dbt ls --select X --exclude Y`): names, tag:, path:, source:, + and N+ operators, unions and intersections.
languageModelTools.userDescription: The models a dbt selector picks (like `dbt ls --select X --exclude Y`): names, tag:, path:, source:, + and N+ operators, unions and intersections.
